notes:
Overview: Enterprise data platform focused on regulated analytics for EU financial services. Security-first procurement: primary requirement is Private VPC with strict egress controls and KMS key control.

Key quotes and asks:
- 'We cannot have data exfiltration — egress to internet must be locked down; outbound only through proxy with allowlist.' — Head of Security
- Wants BYOK/HSM integration and per-tenant key isolation; needs KMS latency/SLA details.

Network security requirements (explicit):
- Private connectivity: prefer AWS PrivateLink endpoints or dedicated VPC peering; cross-account peering acceptable if no public endpoints.
- Firewall rules: deny-by-default; only allow specific CIDR ranges (private subnets) and service ports. Need example rules for port 443+ ephemeral ranges used by runtime.
- Egress controls: require egress through company-managed NAT/proxy; Redwood must document external endpoints and IP ranges for allowlisting.
- IP allowlists: strict list for control-plane IPs; ops will maintain allowlist in their firewall. Request sample IP range CSV.

Security review status / timeline:
- 2026-02-10: Intro call (AE+SE) — high-level requirements captured. (ff_2026-02-14_archipelago_intro)
- 2026-02-14: Sent security checklist + SOC2/ISO attestation pack.
- 2026-02-20: SE walkthrough with infra team; flagged KMS SLA and egress IPs as blockers.
- 2026-02-28: CISO pre-review — requested architectural diagram showing PrivateLink vs peering tradeoffs.

Technical preferences and constraints:
- Primary cloud: AWS (eu-west-1). Secondary: GCP for DR.
- Data residency: Primary storage and logs must remain within eu-west-1; audit logs retention policy required (12 months default, 7+ years possible).
- Audit logging: need tamper-evident logs, S3 with encryption, and CloudTrail-style exports.
- Model routing: prefer deterministic routing to private Dedicated nodes for PII-heavy workloads; fallback to Redwood-hosted variants only with explicit CISO approval.

POC scope suggested by AE/SE:
- Build VPC peering + PrivateLink proof: one model (embedding) running in Dedicated pool within Archipelago VPC; show end-to-end request path, sample firewall rules, and KMS-encrypted KV cache.
- Deliverables: peering diagram, ip-range CSV, sample iptables/ security group rules, KMS integration runbook, audit-log retention plan.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Budget band: mid-six to low-seven figures ARR; prefers 12–24 month committed contract for Dedicated or Private.
- Legal: Data processing addendum required; additional clause for UK data residency.
